description_en: Creates an O&M window. When the TargetResource parameter of the O&M window is associated with ECS instances and underlying hardware risks require scheduled O&M for mitigation, the execution time of the scheduled O&M is determined by the time range specified in the TimePeriod parameter. When the execution time of an O&M event arrives, the platform automatically performs the corresponding O&M operations based on the type of the O&M event
description_zh: 创建运维窗口。当运维窗口TargetResource参数设置关联的ECS实例，底层发生硬件隐患，需要通过计划运维来规避的时候，计划运维的执行时间会根据运维窗口TimePeriod 参数设置的区间来设置。当到达运维事件的执行时间后，平台会自动根据运维事件的类型来执行响应的运维操作

name: CreatePlanMaintenanceWindow

parameters.help_en: The name of the O&M window. You can customize the name. The name can be up to 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 运维窗口的名称，可以自定义。长度不超过200给字符
parameters.name: plan_window_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the window.

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
启用或禁用窗口

true：启用。
false：禁用
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The O&M operations supported by the O&M window
parameters.help_zh: 运维窗口支持的运维操作
parameters.name: support_maintenance_action

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This parameter is required for Alibaba Cloud SDK routing. However, setting any region ID for this operation makes no difference. The O&M window applies to all ECS instances across the network that meet the resource filtering conditions
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。因为阿里云SDK路由需要为必填参数。但是对该接口设置任意regionId没有差异， 运维窗口会对全网满足资源过滤条件的ECS生效
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The type of the cycle. Daily indicates daily recurrence, and Weekly indicates weekly recurrence
fields.help_zh: 周期的类型，每日循环Daily,每周循环Weekly
fields.name: period_unit

fields.help_en:
The end time of the O&M window.

If PeriodUnit is set to Weekly, the format is Monday,22:00. Monday can be replaced with Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, or Sunday.
If PeriodUnit is set to Daily, the format is 22:00.
The comma (,) is used as a separator. The first part represents the hour, with valid values from 00 to 23. The second part represents the minute, and only 00 is supported
fields.help_zh:
运维窗口的结束时间

PeriodUnit 取值 Weekly 窗口期格式为 Monday,22:00 。Monday 可替换为：Tuesday,Wednesday,Thursday,Friday,Saturday,Sunday
PeriodUnit 取值 Daily 窗口期格式为 22:00 。
”，”分割符号 第一部分表达为小时，取值 00~23；第二部分表示分钟，目前支持00
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The start time of the O&M window.
If PeriodUnit is set to Weekly, the format is Monday,22:00. Monday can be replaced with Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, or Sunday.
If PeriodUnit is set to Daily, the format is 22:00.
The comma (,) is used as a separator. The first part represents the hour, with valid values from 00 to 23. The second part represents the minute, and only 00 is supported
fields.help_zh:
运维窗口的开始时间
PeriodUnit 取值 Weekly 窗口期格式为 Monday,22:00 。Monday 可替换为：Tuesday,Wednesday,Thursday,Friday,Saturday,Sunday
PeriodUnit 取值 Daily 窗口期格式为 22:00 。
”，”分割符号 第一部分表达为小时，取值 00~23；第二部分表示分钟，目前支持00
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The time ranges for the recurrence cycle of the O&M window in UTC
fields.help_zh: 运维窗口循环周期的时间段（UTC时区）
fields.name: range_list

parameters.help_en: The recurrence cycle of the window
parameters.name: time_period

fields.help_en: The ID of the resource group. This parameter is required when Scope is set to ResourceGroup
fields.help_zh: Scope 为 ResourceGroup时需要填写 ，资源组的ID
fields.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The resource type configured for the O&M window
fields.help_zh: 配置运维窗口的资源类型
fields.name: scope

fields.help_en: The key of the tag to which the window applies
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag to which the window applies
fields.help_zh: 窗口生效的 tag 的 value
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The tags to which the O&M window applies. This parameter is required when Scope is set to Tag
fields.help_zh: Scope 为 Tag 时需要填写 ，运维窗口生效的标签
fields.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The resources to which the O&M window applies
parameters.name: target_resource

PlanWindowId.description_en: The ID of the created O&M window
PlanWindowId.description_zh: 创建完成的运维窗口的ID
